I should be able to preview the folders   And then, I should also be able to drag and drop notes that I dont like the folder to move it into a different folder if I dont like what AI did. So that means I can remove items from folders and add items to folders via drag and drop.   And then I would like to have a feature that allows me to chat with AI so I can ask it a question and it can ground the answer in a note I have and even find it for me, find a particular note. It should locate and ground the context in two steps — first figuring out the relevant folders it might be in, and then returning the notes in those folders and using that as the basis of their answer. And the thinking of that needs to be surfaced to the user, ie which folders it selected, and which notes is looking through. And the chatbot should answer my question and link me to the notes that are relevant to my topic. Like I click the button in the chatbot and it will bring me to the note that it is referencing. The chatbot needs to be grounded in evidence"

annotations.question: What Gmail API endpoint does the new GmailService use to send messages, and how is the email content encoded for the request?
annotations.answer: It posts to https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send and sends a base64 urlsafe-encoded MIMEText message as the "raw" field.
